row.title: A generated bundle ships with every module migration it carries, never in parts
row.body: The migrations bundle is generated from every module's migrations in dependency order. A slice that carried the bundle but only some of the module SQL drifted from its own tree, and renumbering shifts dozens of files, so the six module migrations and the regenerated bundle ship together (58 files).

title: A generated bundle ships with every module migration it carries, never in parts
